Hello! Once again I am interested in another request, this time a continuation of a previous image. I would like to see these two characters once again, this time with the red character far larger after eating far too much! His brother would still appear near the same size as he does in the original picture, but shocked at how heavy his brother has become!

The red character would be very grumpy at how heavy he has become, still with food in his hand and mouth full, though annoyed at the situation. References for the size I would like him to be has also been included! 
Thank you for your consideration again!

If it is possible I would love to see this large character drawn super huge, floating in a vast digital space looking embarrassed he has become so large. A Size reference has been included to show how large I would like to see him drawn, the size of the other two is up to you, they can either be drawn skinny or chubby. Thank you very much for your consideration as always!

안녕하세요. 이번에 오픈되었다고 해서 신청하게 되었습니다

제가 신청할 내용은요.
내가 보낸 두 개의 링크를 보면 구글 드라이브 링크는 범고래 캐릭터가 나오고, 드롭박스 링크는 나만의 디아루가가 나옵니다.
구글 드라이브가 꽉 차서, 디아루가를 드롭박스로 중얼거렸습니다
범고래 캐릭터와 디아루가를 당신의 그림체로 보고 싶습니다.
체형은 당신의 작품 속에서
(https://skeb.jp/@hiryu_seiruri/works/53)
이 정도 크기로 하고 싶어요.
범고래와 디아루가가 음식을 많이 먹는 대결을 해서 은하계만큼 살이 찌게 됐으면 좋겠어요.
표정은 행복한 표정으로 했으면 좋겠어요.
두 캐릭터 모두 얼굴을 클로즈업 해주시면 좋을 것 같아요.


여기까지 제가 신청할 내용이었습니다.
